repos_data.description: Open-source coordination engine for AI agents, over MCP. Atomic claims, shared ledger, leases, presence, handoffs, tasks. Self-host it or use the hosted service at llm-bus.com.
Local-first shared memory and task coordination for AI coding agents. One Go binary, MCP server, markdown files you own. Hooks for Claude Code and Codex CLI (and their desktop apps).
Local-first MCP server for shared memory, reservations, handoffs, and review evidence across AI coding agents.

The deliberation & governance layer for autonomous organizations. Built like an institution: verifiable audit log, Sybil-resistant reputation, delegated identity, and metered access over MPP + x402/ATXP.
Crash-safe task tracking for AI coding agents over MCP: expiring leases, resumable attempts, version-pinned reviews. One Go binary, one SQLite file per project.
